scenes.title: Your learning home
scenes.caption: Home shows your next lesson, quick links, and a four-step path. Start with one small step.

scenes.title: Six clear destinations
scenes.caption: Use Home, Learn, Modules, Glossary, Simulator, and Progress. On a phone, these actions stay in the bottom navigation.

scenes.title: Help when you need it
scenes.caption: Open underlined terms for definitions. More resources contains tools, videos, and practice labs. Account settings stay in their own menu.

scenes.title: Understand one idea
scenes.caption: Begin with key concepts. Underlined words open plain-language definitions without losing your place.

scenes.title: See it and practice
scenes.caption: Move to a worked example, then consider the practice prompt and summary. Optional videos and reliable sources are available when helpful.

scenes.title: Check your understanding
scenes.caption: Each quiz has five questions. Get at least four correct to pass. If you miss the threshold, review and try again.

scenes.title: One module at a time
scenes.caption: Modules group related lessons. Choose a learning path, expand a module card, and see the lessons inside.

scenes.title: Complete a small chunk
scenes.caption: Open a lesson or the module presentation. Module presentations let you explore concepts, examples, and practice before the quiz.

scenes.title: See your progress grow
scenes.caption: Passed quizzes update your learning progress. Starter content is unlocked first; locked Pro modules remain visible for later.

scenes.title: Practice without real money
scenes.caption: Simulator prices and cash are generated for education. This is a place to practice a process, not predict actual returns.

scenes.title: Read before you act
scenes.caption: Search a symbol, examine its candlestick chart, and use Sprouty’s chart tour to understand the controls. Define what you might lose.

scenes.title: Review your order
scenes.caption: Choose an affordable quantity and review the order before confirming. The first-trade walkthrough explains each step.

scenes.title: Reflect after practice
scenes.caption: Review the completed trade and write a short journal note. Focus on the quality of your reasoning rather than a profit target.

scenes.title: Learning is measurable
scenes.caption: Progress shows lessons, modules, experience points, and your learning streak. These reflect your saved learning activity.

scenes.title: Celebrate the process
scenes.caption: Browse earned and locked achievements. Habits and goals focus on practice, reflection, and consistency, not guaranteed trading profits.

scenes.title: Choose a reminder
scenes.caption: You can download a daily calendar reminder. Import it into your calendar to activate it, and change or remove it there anytime.
